svg.title: OneGrid - Fabric data and analytics
svg.desc: Real-time telemetry and curated history share asset keys, with separate KQL and Import-model serving paths

text.tspan: Capacity / workspace / item permissions | source provenance | independently measured freshness

g.title: PI / historian connector - Canonical source events Durable outbox / checkpoints
Business and history - AIMM / iCare / GADS CMMS / assets / reference data
Azure Blob Storage (optional) - model-outputs files Configured OneLake shortcut
Fabric Eventstream - PIForwarderEndpoint Publish destination / mapping
Eventhouse: PiEventsRaw - Canonical landing table Update policy -> PiEvents
Eventhouse query endpoint - PiEvents / PCIOutages Operational and spatial KQL
Fabric Data Agent (optional) - OneGridOntologyAgent Published semantic-model source
OneLake / Lakehouse - Source landing + og.* tables Site -> unit -> asset -> tag Reliability / work / weather
Notebooks + pipeline - Prepare / features / models Anomaly / Cox / survival / scoring Prediction_Pipeline
Digital Twin Builder - OneGridOntology Table-backed entities / relationships
SQL analytics endpoint - Lakehouse metadata sync Dedicated refresh connection
Import semantic model - OneGridModelImport Refresh after curated-table updates
Azure App Service - OneGrid report BFF / agent DAX + KQL + Data Agent Runtime query identity

text.tspan: Separate runtime and refresh identities | shortcut file access | verified hazard transforms | table-backed ontology and model-grounded Data Agent
Real-time telemetry and curated history share asset keys, with separate KQL and Import-model serving paths
Arrowheads indicate the initiator of a request or the destination of data. Optional components are labeled; dashed boundaries mark a separately controlled scope.
